notes: Finding 1 is correctly polarized: E-012, E-042 and E-057 support platform/integration depth, while E-037 and E-041 weaken a switching-friction inference by documenting multi-PSP behavior and an actual provider replacement. C-005 is correctly retained.

Finding 2 is correctly bounded: E-036 and E-039 support persistence/expansion, while E-037 and E-041 weaken the claim that these relationships are difficult to displace. C-004 and C-005 are both relevant to the bounded wording.
Finding 3 is still mis-polarized. E-044, E-045 and E-046 support the bounded claim that Adyen reports payment-performance benefits while broad independent validation remains limited.

E-043 is not counterevidence to that bounded claim. It is another issuer-hosted selected customer uplift case with an explicit representativeness limitation, so it reinforces both the existence of reported benefit and the stated validation limitation.
The new counterevidence_link makes the model's role assignment auditable, but the explanation does not convert E-043 into genuine evidence that weakens the claim.
The v0.6 contract therefore fixes deterministic ID-format failures and improves auditability, but does not by itself solve natural-language evidence-polarity judgment.

comparison_to_v05_adyen_luna.interpretation: v0.6 materially improves deterministic reference integrity and exposes explicit counterevidence rationale, but the Adyen human-quality result remains non-admissible because a supportive selected-case limitation is still treated as counterevidence to a bounded claim.

budget_snapshot_after_call.display_precision_note: Vercel CLI budget display is rounded and is not used as exact per-call cost evidence.

stop_rule.reason: The v0.6 canary passed deterministic engineering validation but failed the targeted human-quality evidence-polarity criterion.
